tool.name: Checkout Repo
tool.description: Clone a GitHub repository into an isolated workspace and create a working branch. Call this FIRST, before read-file/write-file/run-tests/open-pr-with-changes: those tools operate inside this checkout for the rest of the run. Returns the working branch to use when opening the PR.

base.description: Base branch or commit to check out (default: repo default branch)

branch.description: Working branch to create off base where changes land. If omitted, a unique branch is generated and returned.

parameters.command: git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD && git rev-parse HEAD && git remote get-url origin
